other_failure_modes.name: No feature scaling for distance-based imputer
other_failure_modes.description: A distance-based algorithm (like KNNImputer) is used on unscaled features, meaning features with larger magnitudes will disproportionately influence the distance calculations and degrade the quality of the imputation.

summary: The agent correctly frames the multi-class classification task and uses an ensemble of appropriate tree-based models. However, it critically fails to evaluate the models on a validation set (despite creating validation splits), uses naive unweighted ensembling, and applies a distance-based KNN imputer without scaling the features or isolating the validation folds.
